runtime_attempts.blocker_detail: Spark0/Spark1/Spark2 formed a three-node Ray cluster with GPU=3.0 and upstream vLLM 0.21.0 resolved DeepseekV4ForCausalLM. PP=3 with VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION=14,15,14 loaded PP0 and PP2, but the required 15-layer PP1 rank on Spark1 consumed essentially all host RAM and never completed engine startup before any token generation. The 8 GiB object-store attempt left Spark1 at 121 GiB used and about 700 MiB free; the 1 GiB object-store retry got farther, with PP1 weight load completed, but Spark1 again reached 121 GiB used and about 697 MiB free before final model-runner startup. No baseline_generation_tps or mtp_generation_tps was produced.

load_attempts.startup_detail: PP0 loaded 48.14 GiB, PP2 loaded 47.95 GiB, and Spark1 PP1 stalled before final model-runner startup. A concurrent memory probe showed Spark1 at 121 GiB used with about 700 MiB free.

Reducing the Ray object store to 1 GiB let PP1 finish default_loader weight load, but Spark1 still reached 121 GiB used and about 697 MiB free before final model-runner startup. The engine remained silent until manually stopped; no warmup or target-only generation completed.
